name: @paymux/sdk
description: Type-safe server API, webhook, and browser checkout SDK for Paymux

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm --entry-naming index.js --minify && bun build src/checkout.ts --outdir dist --target browser --format esm --entry-naming paymux-checkout.js --minify && bun build src/global.ts --outdir dist --target browser --format iife --entry-naming paymux-checkout.global.js --minify
